Labs are the planned bridge from each concept to real hardware (VISION.md
sections 1 and 2): theory always lands on something physical.

## Purpose

To connect a concept's figure, animation and simulation to measurements on a
real circuit, and later to a remote FPGA lab.

## Constraints

Lab checks are designed so that student records never enter a repository
(VISION.md section 3).

## Status

Not started: Phase 3, Hardware and breadth (VISION.md section 6).
